name: Equipped gear loot never drops an NPC Equipment placeholder (#10618)
contract: Issue #10618 reports 'NPC Equipment Left Hand - Golem Lord Argelmach (ItemID: 6618)' (2079059) dropping in Lower Blackrock Spire. No loot table references it; it comes from the equipped gear generator (CoA.EquippedGearLoot), which matches DisplayInfoID and slot of the gear a creature wears. Golem Lord Argelmach 8983 is a dungeon boss, which the generator skips before it reads item names, so the fixture is Crimson Conjuror 10419 (level 57-58, not in instance_encounters, wears item 6618: display 5372, slot 13). 2079059 is the only other item on that appearance, with RequiredLevel 52, so it is in band. PlaceholderName (AscensionEquippedGearLoot.cpp) lacked the 'NPC Equipment' prefix. equipped_gear_loot_rate rolls the real corpse-loot path 5000 times per assertion, so the placeholder must never appear. Crimson Conjuror takes a random one of four displays per spawn, and a metric run against it showed generated gear (4.62 percent of corpses) in one spawn, so the fixture is not rejected by the generator's creature gate.
